title: Oven Grilled Kenyan Snapper Grill
description: Tangy, crisp, show‑off Kenyan dish featuring red snapper, robata‑grill, dairy‑free‑friendly.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Pat snapper fillets dry with paper towels and place them on the prepared sheet.
Brush the seasoning mixture generously over both sides of each fillet.
Roast fillets in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, then rotate the sheet to even the cooking.
Continue baking until the fish flakes easily with a fork and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C), about 2 more minutes.
Remove fillets and let rest for a minute before sprinkling fresh cilantro over the top.
Serve immediately with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple salad.
